checkin.landingLead: Install the flight_vis app to fly with the club.
checkin.androidStep1: On Android, allow installs from this source (your browser) in Settings.
checkin.androidStep2: Download the APK with the button above and open it to install.
checkin.androidStep3: Open the app and scan the club QR to check in.
checkin.installSteps: Allow app installs from your browser in Android Settings, download the package, and open it to finish installing.
checkin.expiredBody: The code expired or is invalid. Ask the club for a new QR and scan again.

app.title: Sideload the tracker app
app.subtitle: Install the heavenly.cl flight tracker on your phone. No Play Store required.
app.sideloadStep1: On Android, open **Settings → Apps → Special access → Install unknown apps** and allow your browser to install packages.
app.sideloadStep2: Download the APK using the button above and open it to install. If Chrome only saves the file, open it from **Downloads** or the **Files** app.
app.sideloadStep3: After install, grant location **Allow all the time** so GPS positions keep recording in the background.
app.sideloadStep4: Set battery usage for the app to **Unrestricted** so Android does not stop tracking during flight.
app.uninstallNotice: If you installed an earlier beta of the app, **uninstall it before installing this one**: the Android package name changed, so it will not update in place.
